options.en: She is playing a game now.
She is reading a book now.
She is writing a letter now.
He is sleeping on a sofa.
She is singing in the park.
She is waiting for a bus.
He is playing with a ball.
She is reading a magazine now.
She is listening to a teacher.

passages.title: Computer Room Notice
lines: The computer room will be closed on Friday.
Mr. Chen will fix the old computers.
You can use the computers again on Saturday morning.
Please ask at the front desk if you need help.

questions.en: Why will the room be closed on Friday?
questions.zh: 為什麼星期五這間教室會關閉？
options: Mr. Chen will fix the computers.

questions.en: When can people use the computers again?
questions.zh: 大家什麼時候可以再用電腦？

passages.title: Repair Shop (Tuesday)
lines: Hi Ms. Lee,
Mr. Chen will come to your home on Tuesday at 2:00.
He will fix your door. It takes one hour.
Please call us if you cannot be at home.
Thank you!

questions.en: What will Mr. Chen do on Tuesday?
questions.zh: 陳先生星期二要做什麼？

questions.en: What should Ms. Lee do if she cannot be at home?
questions.zh: 如果李女士那天不在家，她該怎麼做？
options: Come to the shop on Tuesday
Send a letter to Mr. Chen

passages.title: Ms. Lee (new job)
lines: Hi Ms. Park! Today is my first day at the new office.
I start at 8:30. My manager is very kind.
We have lunch with the team at 12:00.
Can you call me this evening?

questions.en: What will Ms. Lee do at 12:00?
questions.zh: 李女士十二點會做什麼？

questions.en: What does Ms. Lee want Ms. Park to do?
questions.zh: 李女士希望朴女士做什麼？

passages.title: Job at Sun Cafe
lines: Sun Cafe needs help in the morning.
Work three days a week, starting at 7:00.
You do not need any experience.
Call Ms. Park if you want to work with us.

questions.en: How many days a week is the job?
Who should a person call about the job?
questions.zh: 想應徵這份工作要打給誰？

passages.title: Library Rules
lines: You can borrow five books at one time.
You can keep each book for two weeks.
Please bring the books back on time.
Do not eat in the library.

questions.en: How long can you keep a book?
What is not allowed in the library?
questions.zh: 圖書館裡不可以做什麼？

passages.title: English class has a new room
lines: Hi students,
This week our English class is in Room 3, not Room 2.
The class still begins at 6:30 on Thursday.
Please bring a book. See you there!
Ms. Park

questions.en: Why is Ms. Park writing this email?
questions.zh: 朴老師為什麼寫這封電子郵件？
options: To change the day of the class
To say the class has a new room

passages.title: Mr. Chen (work)
lines: Hi Ms. Lee, the meeting is now at 3:00, not 2:00.
We will meet in the small room.
Please bring your computer with you.
See you then!

questions.en: What should Ms. Lee bring to the meeting?
questions.zh: 李女士要帶什麼去開會？

passages.title: Clothes Sale
lines: Good clothes for sale at Green Street Shop.
Hats are $10. Shirts are $20.
We are open every day from 10:00 to 6:00.
Buy two shirts and get a hat for free!

questions.en: What do you get if you buy two shirts?
questions.zh: 買兩件襯衫可以得到什麼？
